text: Why do the wings go up on this corkscrew?
Twist the top, and the screw winds down into the cork.
The shaft has teeth, and each wing ends in a small gear.
So as the shaft sinks, its teeth turn both gears, and the wings swing up.
Now push the wings down. The gears drive the shaft back up, and the cork comes with it.
Shaft down, wings up. Wings down, cork out.
